blurb: Room Escapers offers a selection of immersive and interactive escape room experiences with varied themes like apothecary mysteries, organized crime investigations, and treasure hunts. Each game is based on a story or mission, often inspired by real New England and Boston history. Games are designed to engage teams in problem-solving and teamwork in large, themed sets.
extraNote: No refunds, and no shows will not be re-scheduled · Games can be rescheduled due to illness or a voucher provided · Contact at least 48 hours prior for booking changes · Partial refunds for absent players · Same-day rescheduling available
